outcome: Time of onset of stage II lactogenesis (breast-milk production)
cohort: The study included 126 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS).
finding: The average time for onset of stage II lactogenesis was 5.6 days with conservative management compared to 3.8 days with cesarean hysterectomy, and postpartum progesterone levels were significantly lower in the cesarean hysterectomy group.
mod_finding: Individuals undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for PAS experienced a shorter average time to stage II lactogenesis and significantly lower postpartum progesterone levels compared to those managed with placental retention.
